facts.fact: Nalubega and Uwizeyimana (University of Johannesburg) report a URA respondent saying an AI component of ASYCUDA is used to profile and manage risk, detect fraud and target customs audits; the paper, submitted 19 August 2023, gives no interview dates.

The same study reports UNMA respondents saying an AI-based forecasting computer, launched in early 2022, produces weather predictions from real-time weather-station data; the paper, submitted 19 August 2023, gives no interview dates.

Nalubega and Uwizeyimana report AI in service in two sectors' public systems, customs risk profiling at URA and weather forecasting at UNMA, among six agencies they found using AI; the paper, submitted 19 August 2023, gives no interview dates.
facts.system: URA customs and UNMA forecasting AI

systems.platform: forecasting supercomputer fed by IoT weather stations

systems.system: UIA AI queue management in CRM

systems.platform: smart prepaid meters with tamper alerts

note: Interview-based; the queue system is general administration, and SCADA alarms, smart meters and sensor monitoring are described without any AI output, so they are other. No measured results.
